Microbiom Store.title: Microbiome Store
Microbiom Store.desc: A walk-in shop for gut health: live fermented foods, cultures and home-fermenting kits on the shelf, plus a counter where a microbiome test can be bought, dropped off and talked through.
Microbiom Store.gap: Gap confirmed — no dedicated store found in Rhine-Main
Microbiom Store.gapSub: The pieces exist, scattered across 12 unrelated businesses.

refs.name: Hakko Department
refs.desc: Fermented-food grocery and café founded by fermentation specialist Hiraku Ogura. Miso, soy sauce, sake, rice-bran pickling kits; the café menu is built on fermented dishes.
refs.why: The retail-plus-café shape, with a curator as the brand.

refs.name: The Cultured Pickle Shop
refs.desc: Small-batch fermented vegetables, kombucha, miso and amazake from Northern California produce; a rice-bowl café on weekends. Described by Visit Berkeley as 28 years old.
refs.why: Nearly three decades of survival on ferments alone.

refs.name: Every Good Thing
refs.desc: Bristol's first dedicated fermented-food shop, opened in a container unit (Oct 2020) by a scientist with a microbial-genetics background. Cultures, kefir grains, kimchi, kombucha, equipment; production kitchen and workshops two days a week.
refs.why: Expert-led advice is the product; tiny footprint. Current trading status not re-checked.

refs.name: Café Bärbucha
refs.desc: Fermenter and deli since 2015: 22 kombucha varieties, sauerkraut, kimchi, fermented mushrooms, oxymel, tinctures, fermenting sets and books. Eisenacher Str. 73.
refs.why: A German proof point — ten years in the market.

refs.name: The Functional Gut Clinic
refs.desc: Founded 2014. Gut diagnostics — including microbiome analysis, SIBO and intolerance testing — with specialist interpretation of results. CQC-regulated, plus mobile clinics inside NHS centres.
refs.why: The "test + someone explains it" half of the concept, scaled to three cities.

refs.name: Mediclinic Precise — gut microbiome package
refs.desc: Direct-to-consumer microbiome test sold by a hospital group, with AI meal planning, in-person or virtual consultations, and kit pick-up and drop-off (2025).
refs.why: A large operator treating the drop-off counter as a service. Source is sponsored content.

Functional Drink Bars.title: Functional Drinks Bar
Functional Drink Bars.desc: A bar for drinks that do something: adaptogen and mushroom elixirs, kombucha and kefir on tap, tonic shots and alcohol-free cocktails — somewhere to go out in the evening without alcohol, and to buy the drinks to take home.
Functional Drink Bars.gap: Gap confirmed — no elixir, tonic or alcohol-free bar found in Rhine-Main
Functional Drink Bars.gapSub: Daytime smoothie and matcha bars are edging toward it.

refs.name: Erewhon Tonic & Juice bars
refs.desc: Counters inside the Erewhon grocer selling made-to-order functional shots for about 14 years, plus bottled 2-oz shots — turmeric, ginger, chlorophyll, adaptogen blends built from products on the shelves.
refs.why: Management says the shots are likely bringing new customers into the stores.

refs.loc: Los Angeles · Venice, Silver Lake, West Hollywood
refs.name: Moon Juice
refs.desc: Adaptogen "dust" lattes at $5–8 in its cafés, with the same powders sold online at $38 a bottle. One kiosk (Ace Hotel Downtown) has closed.
refs.why: The bar works as showroom for a packaged product line. Location count is from 2018.

refs.name: Jarr Kombucha Bar
refs.desc: Billed as Europe's first kombucha taproom: a rotating range poured fresh from the tap, beside a scene of restaurants and pubs adding kombucha to their own menus.
refs.why: Kombucha can carry a taproom on its own. Source dates from 2018.

refs.name: Club Soda Tasting Room
refs.desc: Alcohol-free bar and bottle shop, opened late 2022. Mood-enhancing drinks became more than half of its cocktail sales. Closed after about three years when the lease ended; the owners are looking for a new site.
refs.why: Demand for the "functional" part is real; the lease, not the concept, ended this one.

refs.name: Kava bars
refs.desc: Around 700 bars today, up from 178 in 2019. No kitchen, few licences, open from morning past midnight. But at some bars kratom drinks are 60–70% of sales, and cities and states are cracking down.
refs.why: Proof that a no-alcohol evening venue scales — and a warning about which ingredients to keep out.

refs.name: Define Foods Tea + Elixir Bar
refs.desc: Elixir bar inside the Define Living wellness space: reishi and He Shou Wu elixirs, mushroom coffee with adaptogens, custom tea blends, dine-in or to go.
refs.why: A low-cost shop-in-shop entry next to a studio audience. Source dates from 2017.

Herbal Pharmacy.title: Herbal Pharmacy
Herbal Pharmacy.desc: A walk-in herbal dispensary: hundreds of loose medicinal herbs in jars, house blends and tinctures made on site, and a trained herbalist behind the counter who listens and mixes for you — the apothecary, not the spice shop.
Herbal Pharmacy.gap: Gap confirmed — no herbal dispensary found in Rhine-Main
Herbal Pharmacy.gapSub: Herbs are sold as spice and tea, prescribed in TCM practices, and dispensed by ordinary pharmacies.

stats.t: reference businesses in London, Edinburgh, Boulder, New York, Vienna and Munich
herbal apothecaries, Kräuterdrogerien or TCM pharmacies surfaced in the region
search queries run across the region, 12 adjacent results logged below

refs.name: Neal's Yard Remedies
refs.desc: A dispensary of dried herbs alongside its own remedies and organic skin care; most London stores also have treatment rooms. An early mover in the organic movement of the 1980s.
refs.why: Proof the format can become a chain — herbs at the core, therapy rooms as the second revenue line.

refs.name: Napiers the Herbalists
refs.desc: Founded in 1860 and described as Scotland's biggest herbal remedy supplier, with shops plus clinics for acupuncture and counselling. In 2012 it went into provisional liquidation to restructure after trading slumped and new EU herbal-medicine rules took effect.
refs.why: 150+ years of demand — and a warning that regulation can reshape the model overnight.

refs.name: Rebecca's Herbal Apothecary & Supply
refs.desc: Opened 2004 by a medical-herbalism teacher. About 200 bulk herbs in glass jars, small-batch teas and body care made on site, low markups. Six part-time certified herbalists on staff; consultations are referred out to local practitioners.
refs.why: A lean, retail-only version that avoids clinical claims.

refs.name: Kamwo Meridian Herbs
refs.desc: Open since 1973 and billed as the largest and oldest Chinese herbal dispensary on the US East Coast, selling precise combinations of dried herbs for complaints such as stress and poor circulation.
refs.why: The TCM dispensary version, five decades in.

refs.name: Die Kräuterdrogerie
refs.desc: Herbs, teas and hard-to-find Alpine essential oils with staff who walk customers through the range, plus a small lunch counter. Kochgasse 34; 4.8 from 139 Google reviews.
refs.why: The German-speaking Drogerie tradition, kept alive in a capital city.

refs.name: Fraunhofer Apotheke
refs.desc: A licensed pharmacy positioned as a TCM pharmacy with mail order; reviewers praise holistic advice, including by phone. It was the only result returned when searching for a TCM pharmacy in Frankfurt.
refs.why: Shows the fully licensed German route — and that Frankfurt searches lead to Munich.

refs.name: Zielarnia Zdrowia
refs.desc: Polish herbal shop (zielarnia) with medicinal herbs, herbal blends and natural products, online and in store.
refs.why: A Polish example of the herbal shop format.

Herbal Pharmacy.cmpIntro: The herbs are sold here as spice and tea; the knowledge sits in TCM and Heilpraktiker practices. Nobody joins the two at a counter you can walk up to.
Herbal Pharmacy.method: Method: Google Places and web search on 12 Oct 2026, cross-checked against the Sept 2026 Frankfurt consumer-health scan. "Not found" is strong for registered shops and weaker for market stalls and pharmacies that run an herbal counter without advertising it — verify on the ground before acting. Regulatory note: in Germany, herbs sold as medicines generally fall under drug law and many are pharmacy-only. Decide early whether this is a licensed Apotheke or a tea-and-herb shop that stays clear of health claims; this is not legal advice. Reference details are as reported by the linked sources; some articles are years old and trading status was not re-verified.
